description: Tech Lead-posture skill that plans a hand-opened 飛び石 Tobiishi end to end, so the chain can carry it from the content step, or from implementation when the change publishes no text, onward. Takes a quote-checked brief beside the change's change_request.md — confirmed by the owner in a session, or the Request itself when unattended — grounds every claim against the repository, opens the change's worktree, and writes a stub change_spec.md, a stub change_design.md, and a full tl_instruction.md in development-plan's shape, with a report beside the brief. Requires Tech Lead posture and halts outside a tech-lead session or the tech-lead subagent. The run itself never interviews — when the repository cannot settle something it stops and says what would settle it. Use when a change has been opened by hand and should be planned in one pass rather than walked through development-specs, development-design and development-plan.
